blurb: Collusion Tap Works operates taprooms in York and Lititz, PA, offering a variety of craft beers, ciders, and meads brewed on premises. The York taproom features 24 taps and a kitchen with seasonal, locally-sourced menus. They also offer a private event space called The Side Show for various events and a draft trailer rental for mobile beer service.
